details.description: Grok 4.20 (reasoning) is the reasoning-mode variant of xAI's Grok 4.20, whose system card is dated April 7, 2026, documented with a 1,000,000-token context window. xAI's docs describe it as having 'the lowest hallucination rate on the market with strict prompt adherence.' It takes text and image input, produces text output, and the same underlying model can also be deployed in a separate multi-agent mode. This catalog id is one of several aliases xAI's own docs list for the model, all resolving to the dated checkpoint grok-4.20-0309-reasoning. Artificial Analysis's current benchmarking marks this snapshot deprecated in favor of xAI's newer Grok 4.3.
advantages: xAI describes it as having the lowest hallucination rate on the market with strict prompt adherence, per xAI's docs.
Scores 26 on Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index.
Artificial Analysis reports an output speed of 101.1 tokens/second.
Can also run in a multi-agent mode where multiple agents collaborate in parallel, per xAI's docs.
xAI's system card reports a 0.00 violation rate on its internal chat-refusal safety evaluation in single-agent mode.
disadvantages: Artificial Analysis reports a time to first token of 21.53 seconds, far slower than the non-reasoning variant of Grok 4.20.
Not designed or intended for high-risk applications such as autonomous medical, legal, financial or safety-critical decisions without human oversight, per xAI's Grok 4.20 system card.
Artificial Analysis marks this snapshot deprecated, naming Grok 4.3 (high) as a newer alternative.
use_cases: General-purpose assistant tasks requiring step-by-step reasoning: research, analysis and complex question answering
Multimodal reasoning over text and images

notes: The catalog id 'grok-4.20-experimental-beta-reasoning-latest' is one of several aliases xAI's docs list for the model id grok-4.20-0309-reasoning (confirmed on docs.x.ai/developers/models/grok-4.20-0309-reasoning, whose alias list explicitly includes '-experimental-beta' and '-latest' forms, plus the bare 'grok-4.20'). Artificial Analysis states a 2.0M-token context window for this snapshot, which conflicts with the catalog's 1,000,000; the catalog figure was kept per instructions. xAI's system card names supported languages only as examples (English, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, Spanish, 'and several dozen others with varying levels of capability') without a closed list, so languages is left empty. xAI's own current models page still lists the model with no deprecation flag and the catalog carries no deprecation_date; only Artificial Analysis (third-party) marks this snapshot deprecated, in favor of Grok 4.3.
